English: Snow Shelter
Makeshift snow-packed earthworks and windbreaks provide basic shelter for settlers braving the Arctic elements.
Fur Storage
Timber-and-ice storehouses for valuable furs and pelts, securing trade goods and modestly enriching the city.
Ice Hut
Small communal huts of packed snow and ice, providing marginally improved shelter and warmth for city dwellers.
Smokehouse
Large communal smokehouses preserve game and fish, ensuring food stores last through the harshest winters and increasing city prosperity.
Sled Workshop
Specialized workshops produce sturdy sleds for transport, boosting trade and movement in the frozen city.
Reindeer Pen
Fenced wooden pens shelter reindeer herds, bolstering food security and local wealth. Herding skills spread among the cityfolk.
Blubber Depot
Grand insulated depots for storing whale blubber and oil, fueling lamps, trade, and city industry with precious Arctic resources.
Snow Wall
Massive frozen ramparts surround the city, offering formidable protection against attackers and the elements alike.
Heated Hall
A vast, fire-warmed central hall, gathering citizens for council, trade, and governance, heart of Arctic urban life.
Polar Compound
A fortified, multi-structure urban complex with heated halls, guarded stores, and bustling trade, unmatched in the high Arctic.
